selected.rationale: Delay on the critical compose-post->post-storage edge stalls every post creation; with no client timeout, latency propagates unboundedly to the API.
unique-id is a required global dependency for post IDs; delaying it blocks all write requests before any downstream work.
home-timeline fan-out from compose-post is synchronous; a delay here adds directly to compose latency and can block publishing.
Loss on the post-storage edge causes write failures; absence of retry defense leaves the post unpersisted and user-facing errors.
Reading timelines depends on home-timeline->post-storage; delay makes timeline retrieval hang, exposing read-path latency propagation.
user-timeline update is another compose fan-out edge; delay slows every post and may cause partial inconsistency.
Killing post-storage removes the persistence layer, breaking both writes and reads and exposing availability loss.
Killing compose-post eliminates the write API; the inability to recover/quickly restore service reveals missing recovery behavior.
